title: Choose Construct's new visual world
question: The roll assigned Drafting Vellum. Keep it, take Impeccable's pick, adopt a challenger, or re-roll.

options.label: Drafting Vellum
options.lineage: Architects' tracing vellum, scale rules and revision-marked drawing sets
options.thesis: Construct as the firm's drawing set: every quantity is dimensioned, every unapproved change is a revision.
options.viewport: Graphite rail, work on stacked vellum sheets; the room view draws L, B and H as true dimension strings, and pending BOQ edits carry a red revision delta.
options.risk: If dimension strings spread beyond real measurements it turns into drafting cosplay.

raised.raise: The BOQ header carries guide words: the first and last section in view, updated as you scroll.
Non-photo blue is reserved for the one active thing (current selection or step), never decoration.
Every figure uses one tabular numeral style at data density, right-aligned on a shared decimal edge.

options.label: Material Library
options.lineage: The studio's sample wall: laminate chips, veneer leaves, tile samples and shade cards
options.thesis: Catalog and BOQ as the sample board a scheme gets pinned to.
options.viewport: Walnut-dark rail; categories as sample chips, products as edge-labelled sample tiles; each BOQ section headed by its material chip strip.
options.risk: Closest to the warm look you just rejected; chips must stay tiny on dense BOQ screens or they turn decorative.

options.label: Lexicon Shoulder and Plate
options.thesis: Every screen as a dictionary spread with guide words and colour plates.
options.viewport: Black text columns with a shoulder index; colour confined to plates.
options.case: A book world: your team doesn't identify with it, and setting it to a reading measure fights a wide BOQ table.
options.kept: Guide words naming the span you're inside, for the long BOQ.
options.risk: Reads as a document, not a working tool.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: Projects as terrain with the active route in purple.
options.viewport: Terrain colour fields beneath a numbered course.
options.case: Strong colour discipline, but terrain has nothing to do with fit-out work.
options.kept: One colour reserved for the active thing only.
options.risk: Outdoor-sport costume on an office tool.

options.label: Monochrome Product
options.thesis: Near-black on near-white with one accent used sparingly.
options.viewport: Grey shell, one accent, dense screenshots.
options.case: This is the 'looks like any other one' problem you just named.
options.kept: Nothing new; the accent budget is already covered by the blue reserve.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.thesis: One item owns the screen; the next is one flick away.
options.viewport: One room per screen with a right-hand action rail.
options.case: Wrong for dense desktop BOQ work, and too playful for costs.
options.kept: On a phone, the room view gives one room the whole screen.
options.risk: Entertainment register on a finance tool.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.thesis: Areas as swelling lobes of flat colour.
options.viewport: One colour lobe per screen with capsule buttons.
options.risk: Undermines trust in costs and approvals.

options.label: Datamatics
options.viewport: Barcode columns with dense figures in the margin.
options.case: Strobing black and white would wreck long BOQ sessions.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean modern SaaS tool like Linear or Notion, done impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Light sidebar, neutral tables and one indigo accent.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
